snippet.title: Employee 925 - Old Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948890/Employee_925/
itch.io: https://jantunes.itch.io/employee925

Employee 925 is a short existential horror game about work, meritocracy, and performance evaluation.

Every day, you arrive at your desk.
Every day, you do the job.
Every day, you go ██████.
And then… you come back.

You are trapped in a cycle — a workday with no clear end.
Your tasks are vague, your workplace endless, and your role unquestionable.
Your name: forgotten.
Your identity: disposable.

Features

A loop without exit — The day always starts the same, and plays out the same. Please comply.
Fun mandatory training — Let us improve together.
Morse as language — Words are dangerous.
Unsettling familiarity — A world in shades of purple and green, where routine is the true horror.
Clock in. Work. Clock out. Repeat. Comply. Comply. Comply.
